description: Average over only the order items that have invoice line items.

b.request: For each order item with at least one invoice line item, calculate the average of `product_price / derived_total_cost` across its invoice line items, excluding rows where the ratio is missing, and count its invoice line items; then return one row with the average of the nonmissing per-item ratio averages and the average invoice line item count across those order items.
b.sql:
WITH per_item AS (
  SELECT
    ili.order_item_id,
    AVG(1.0 * ili.product_price / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS invoice_line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_of_item_ratio_averages,
  AVG(1.0 * invoice_line_item_count) AS average_invoice_line_item_count
FROM per_item;
b.raw: For each order item with at least one invoice line item, calculate the average of `product_price / derived_total_cost` across its invoice line items, excluding rows where the ratio is missing, and count its invoice line items; then return one row with the average of the nonmissing per-item ratio averages and the average invoice line item count across those order items.

c.request: Per order item, work out the average of `product_price` ÷ `derived_total_cost` over its invoice line items (skipping missing ratios) and how many invoice line items it has. In a single row, what are the overall average of those per-item ratios (ignoring missing ones) and the average number of invoice line items per order item? Average over only the order items that have invoice line items.
c.sql:
WITH per_order_item AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    AVG(product_price / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS invoice_line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio,
  AVG(invoice_line_item_count) AS avg_invoice_line_items_per_order_item
FROM per_order_item;

a.request: For each order item that appears in the invoice line items, take the average of `product_price` divided by `derived_total_cost` across its invoice line items (skipping missing ratios), and count its invoice line items. Then return one row with the average of those per-item average ratios (ignoring missing ones) and the average of those per-item line-item counts.
a.sql:
WITH per_order_item AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    AVG(product_price / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_per_item_ratio,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS average_per_item_line_item_count
FROM per_order_item;

d.request: Calculate each order item’s average `product_price` / `derived_total_cost` across its invoice line items, excluding missing ratios, and its invoice line item count; then return the overall average of the per-item averages, ignoring missing ones, and the average line item count, considering only order items with invoice line items.
d.sql:
WITH per_item AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    AVG(CASE
      WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL
       AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
       AND derived_total_cost <> 0
      THEN product_price * 1.0 / derived_total_cost
    END) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_per_item_ratio,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_item_count
FROM per_item;
